questions.stem: A 28-year-old male presents to the emergency department following an alleged sexual assault by a man. The victim recalls that the assault occurred approximately 4 hours ago. Which of the following examination findings would least likely support evidence of the current sodomy assault?

options.label: A
options.text: Linear abrasions or contusions in the perianal region

options.label: C
options.text: Paradoxical dilatation of anus during bimanual traction of buttocks
